note: The JavaScript input buffer provided to Hermes becomes the lexer's source buffer.
The lexer cursor is initialized to the beginning of the input-controlled buffer.
The input escape sequence starts with \u{, so lexing dispatches into braced code point parsing.
The loop advances through attacker-controlled characters until a closing brace or end of buffer is seen.

note: The return value is ignored; when the error limit is reached, error() forces curCharPtr_ to bufferEnd_ but this function continues the loop instead of returning.
Reaching the lexer error limit calls forceEOF, which moves the cursor to bufferEnd_.
The cursor is set to the end sentinel while consumeBracedCodePoint will still execute the loop increment.
After the for-loop increment moves the cursor past bufferEnd_, the next loop condition reads one byte beyond the input buffer.
